sn17.12:1.3: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi
sn17.12:1.4: na vāyamāyasmā rūpiyapātiyāpi suvaṇṇacuṇṇa paripūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyāti
sn17.12:1.5: tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādinnacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
